store.tagline: Blackjack on felt, arrows or mouse; the bankroll persists
features: A casino table in the panel: the Kenney deck dealt from a shoe in the order a dealer deals (player, dealer, player, hole), the hole card turning over, a split's hands sliding apart, chips for the bet
One-handed: `up` and `down` set the bet and `Enter` deals; then `up` hit, `down` stand, `right` double, `left` split; letters `H S D P` too
Every move is a button with its keys on it, and `cmd+k` lists the legal ones; the title line says the phase (`Place your bet`, `Your turn`, `Dealer busts`)
A win glows, a bust shakes, a blackjack gets a flourish; the bankroll counts to its new value and totals read `Soft 17`
Dealer stands on 17 (H17 by setting), blackjack pays 3:2, a dealer blackjack is checked at once, doubling after a split allowed, no surrender; insurance by setting
Escape leaves at any point; the hand, the bankroll and the record are there when you come back, across restarts
